evidence.summary: Microscopist on 2 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 5 observations; candidates: Microtubule stabilizers, Microtubule destabilizers, Eg5 inhibitors

candidate_mechanisms.why: Rounded shrunken cells with condensed bright DNA, saturated tubulin masses and 39% mitotic-like fraction match antimitotic arrest; strongly increased tub_mean favors stabilization/bundling.
Same rounded mitotic arrest with loss of spread microtubule network and condensed DNA can also occur with depolymerization; cannot exclude from low-resolution texture alone.
Monopolar mitotic arrest also gives small rounded cells with condensed DNA and bright spindle tubulin; rosettes not resolved so remains alternative.

notable_cells.why: Rounded yellow doublet with condensed DNA and saturated tubulin+actin typical of mitotic-like arrest.
Clumped bright yellow cells with small condensed DNA illustrating mitotic-like mass.

observations.finding: Nuclei smaller, brighter and more irregular/condensed vs DMSO uniform oval dim nuclei; agrees with increased nuc_dna_mean z=27.7 and decreased nuc_solidity z=-40.3.
Tubulin much brighter forming solid rounded masses instead of DMSO diffuse filamentous network, with high texture; agrees with increased tub_mean z=30.8 and tub_glcm_contrast z=185.2.
Actin much brighter forming solid rounded masses instead of DMSO spread cortical/fiber staining, highly variable; agrees with increased act_mean z=47.4, act_std z=179.3 and act_glcm_contrast z=138.0.
High proportion of small rounded yellow cells from colocalized bright tubulin+actin around condensed DNA vs rare in DMSO; agrees with frac_mitotic_like 0.39 vs 0.015 z=91.6.
Thin green tubulin-positive projections/bridges between some rounded cells persist; no provided feature measures this, so not covered by measurements.

report.uncertainty: Light microscopy alone cannot definitively separate microtubule stabilizer vs destabilizer vs Eg5 monopolar arrest; all give rounded condensed mitotic phenotype.

candidate_mechanisms.why: Rounded-up cells, loss of spread interphase microtubule network, small condensed nuclei, 20% mitotic-like vs 1.5% DMSO with increased tub_mean, consistent with mitotic arrest by stabilized microtubules.

notable_cells.why: Large bright rounded cell with intense diffuse tubulin/actin and condensed DNA, example of mitotic-like rounding.
Rounded cell with elongated actin-rich tail, example of loss of normal spreading with retained bright cytoskeleton.

observations.finding: Treated fields have many fewer cells than dense spread DMSO monolayer; treated cells are small rounded intensely yellow (green+red overlap) vs flat epithelial DMSO. No cell-count z provided.
Nuclei smaller than DMSO ovals, agrees with nuc_major_axis decrease to 26.9 vs 36.8 dmso median z=-30.1.
More small bright condensed/paired mitotic-like nuclei than DMSO, agrees with frac_mitotic_like 0.204 vs 0.015 z=46.2.
Nuclei appear clumped/irregular vs smooth DMSO ovals, agrees with nuc_solidity decrease z=-43.7.
Tubulin much brighter diffuse solid with no filamentous interphase network vs DMSO, agrees with tub_mean increase z=28.1.
Tubulin texture blotchy high-contrast vs smooth DMSO, agrees with tub_glcm_contrast increase z=138.7.
Actin much brighter solid in rounded cells vs DMSO stress-fiber/cortical pattern, agrees with act_mean increase z=59.7.
Actin highly variable/clumped high-contrast vs DMSO, agrees with act_std increase z=139.0 and act_glcm_contrast increase z=104.4.

report.uncertainty: Single 24h timepoint; bright actin/tubulin partly reflects volume concentration in rounded cells, so cannot separate direct cytoskeletal stabilization from secondary mitotic rounding. Stabilizer vs Eg5/Aurora mitotic arresters overlap morphologically.

reflection.text:
Early evidence was right: 10 uM well w_bdc02a8567 with act_std z=+179.3 and act_glcm_contrast z=+138.0 and 0.3 uM well with act_std z=+66.9 gave NSC 2/2 Actin disruptors, and protocol majority 2/4 remained Actin disruptors. That direct actin texture mass reflects the true cytochalasin D mechanism of capping filaments to block polymerization (PMID 3023337) and capping/severing observed structurally (PMID 40658853).

I overturned that correct lead because two describe_phenotype calls listed only Microtubule stabilizers/destabilizers/Eg5 inhibitors and never actin, k-neighbours were 5/10 Eg5 inhibitors, and dose_response showed frac_mitotic_like rho=+1.00, tub_mean rho=+1.00 and cell_area rho=-1.00. I misread rounding/shrinkage and high tub_glcm_contrast z=+185.2 as monopolar mitotic arrest rather than contracted actin-collapsed cells scoring mitotic-like, and misread act_mean rho=+0.80 and falling multinucleate proxy as against cytokinesis failure.

Acquisition choice cemented the error: with only 4 wells spent on 10, 0.3, 1 and 0.1 uM, the 1 uM well called Eg5 inhibitors and 0.1 uM called Protein synthesis at similarity ~0.599, diluting the vote and lowering confidence. I should have weighted extreme act_std z>100 and summed similarity 1.225 for actin over generic mitotic proxies and required a phalloidin fiber check, consistent with actin-cofilin inhibition by cytochalasin D (PMID 22728040), before switching final call to Eg5 inhibitors p=0.52.
what_was_right: High-dose act_std z=+179.3 and act_glcm_contrast z=+138.0 in e2 plus mid-dose act_std z=+66.9 in e3 flagged strong actin cytoskeleton disruption
Early NSC vote 2/2 Actin disruptors in e4 correctly captured the leading class
First submit_conclusion Actin disruptors p=0.42 matched unblinded protocol majority 2/4 with summed similarity 1.225
what_was_wrong: Over-weighted describe_phenotype e5 and e14 which proposed only microtubule/Eg5 candidates and omitted actin, despite low-density rounded cells also seen in actin collapse
Interpreted dose_response frac_mitotic_like rho=+1.00 in e10 and tub_mean rho=+1.00 in e11 as Eg5-specific arrest rather than actin-contraction artifact raising texture contrast
Interpreted cell_area rho=-1.00 in e17 and lower density as Eg5 rounding instead of actin-disruptor shrinkage/detachment
Let k-neighbour Eg5 5/10 in e4/e9 outweigh NSC leading vote and low-similarity warning, leading to final wrong Eg5 inhibitors p=0.52 in e20
